text_en: The entry prescribed in paragraph (1) of the preceding Article must be made by a person who has made a notification in advance by recording their name and address (in the case of a corporation or any other organization, its name, the name of its representative, and the location of its principal office) and any other matters to be used as a reference in a file stored on a special-purpose computer and submitting to the Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry documents confirming the relevant facts.
